description:
Luxury Dog Products That Don't Cost The Earth

At Baker & Bray, we help 'dog parents' to make your precious pooches more comfortable and to naturally promote your dog’s well-being and long-term health.

The origins of the company date back to the 1950's when Margaret Baker and Emily Bray, both talented dressmakers started to make jackets for their own Fox Terriers which inspired Grandson, Richard, to produce a range of luxury, but affordable, dog products.

Fast forward to today and Baker & Bray's mission is to build one of the world’s leading progressive and sustainable dog-focused brands by continuing to create innovative, luxury dog products at sensible prices.

Our Values

  • We believe that all dogs deserve to be safe & comfortable.
  • We are passionate about helping dogs to lead long & healthy lives
  • We aim to help protect our precious planet for our customers & their 'dog parents' alike.

Our high-quality, affordable luxury dog products are developed in an environmentally friendly & sustainable manner and naturally provide health & well-being benefits, promote good behaviour & help to extend the lives of our gorgeous furry friends.

From our award-winning products to our expert help and advice, everything we do is designed and developed in-house within the UK.

Join our affiliate program to offer our Eco Friendly products to your customers and audiences.

1. Introduction

This is an Agreement between you and Printcomm Solutions Ltd t/as Baker & Bray. Please read these terms and conditions carefully. This Agreement outlines the rules and regulations of the Baker & Bray affiliate program.
By accepting these Terms and Conditions, you agree that you have read and understood these and agree to be legally responsible for each and every term and condition herein.

2. Definitions

In this Agreement, the following definitions will apply. 
“Affiliate” or “Affiliates” are the individuals or entities in the affiliate application that intend to participate in the Affiliate Program and who will legally be bound by the Terms and Conditions herein.
“Customers” are the individuals and legal entities that are the end users of Printcomm Solutions Ltd. 
“Affiliate Program” means the Baker & Bray program operated by Printcomm Solutions Ltd, to which the Affiliates are enrolled and rewarded in the form of monetary compensation for referring customers. 
“Affiliate Link” is the personal link from an affiliate participating in the Baker & Bray affiliate program, used to track referrals and commissions. The link is embedded within the affiliate’s website and promotional channels, and when clicked on by a potential customer, it directs website traffic to https://bakerandbray.com. 
“Referral” stands for a potential customer who was led to https://bakerandbray.com.
“Commission” means the money that an affiliate earns from each referral that converts into a sale.
“Abandoned Affiliate Account” means any affiliate account where the Affiliate Dashboard has not been logged into for a period of 12 months, or has no affiliate referrals posted during a period of 6 months.

3. Participation Requirements and Partner Obligations

To be eligible to join the affiliate program, you must agree to the affiliate program terms and conditions: be at least 18 years old and have a functioning website or social media presence.
In the application, you must provide your full name, website address, and any additional information asked. After signing up for the program, we will review your application. Baker & Bray reserves the right and sole discretion to reject your application, and re-evaluate your application at any point in time.  
You are only allowed to create and use one affiliate account. 
You will receive a confirmation of your participation when the application is approved. After approval, you have direct access to your affiliate dashboard and personal referral link.
The affiliate’s main role is to operate as a marketing promoter of Baker & Bray, and to introduce potential customers to the website https://bakerandbray.com. The affiliate is allowed to use their affiliate link on their website and refer potential customers to Baker & Bray.
As a participant in the program, you have the right to market and promote the products and services of Baker & Bray.
The affiliate is responsible for keeping company information on their website and in their promotions up to date. For example, if there is a change in pricing, package, or service at Baker & Bray, it's the affiliate’s sole responsibility that information is updated.

4. Policies and Prohibited Activities

As a condition to your participation in the affiliate program, you agree that while you are an Baker & Bray affiliate, you will comply with all laws, ordinances, rules, regulations, orders, licenses, permits, judgments, decisions, or other requirements (collectively, “Laws”) of any governmental authority that has jurisdiction over you.
This is regardless of whether those Laws are now in effect or later come into effect during the time you are an Affiliate or participating in the affiliate program, including, without limitation, during the application process. 
Without limiting the foregoing obligation, you agree that as a condition of your participation in the affiliate program, you will comply. This is related to all applicable Laws that govern marketing email, including without limitation, the e-Privacy Directive, the CAN-SPAM Act of 2003, and all other anti-spam laws.
By participating in the program, the affiliate agrees that their website and other promotional channels does not contain or promote:
  • Copyright, trademark, or other intellectual property rights.
  • Adult, violent and defamatory content. 
  • Gambling, including and without limitations, sports books, poker, and (online) casinos. 
  • Religious and or political viewpoints. 
  • Any content or services that violate the law. 
Paid promotions and PPC bidding on the following keywords, and misspellings of these, are not allowed: Baker & Bray, Baker & Bray Discount, Baker & Bray Coupon or derivates thereof such as Baker 'and' Bray. It can’t be  separate or in combination with other keywords. In order to use any Baker & Bray related keywords through paid advertising, you need prior approval of one of our affiliate managers. 
We do not work with discount and coupon websites. Coupon codes are not provided to affiliates. Affiliates that display invalid discount codes on their websites or in their promotions will be removed from the affiliate program. Any misleading information to set an affiliate cookie on the potential customer's device is forbidden. This includes any campaigns that aim to mislead the potential customer by representing as Baker & Bray.
Self-referrals are forbidden. This means you can not refer yourself, your immediate family, or the company you work for. You will not receive commission on self-referrals. 
The affiliate shall act in the best interests of Printcomm Solutions Ltd t/as Baker & Bray at all times and in compliance with all relevant and applicable regulations and ethical standards.

5. Commissions and Payments 

Commissions are paid to the affiliate for paying customers that were brought to the Baker & Bray website via the affiliate link, and products or services purchased within 90 days. 90 days is the duration of our affiliate cookie left on the potential customer’s device after clicking the affiliate link. 
We pay commissions on the last day of the month. This is for commission accumulated during the month prior i.e., for the avoidance of doubt, March commissions would be paid on April 30th. Our minimum payment threshold is £50 GBP. Our payout method is PayPal. It is the affiliate’s responsibility to have an accurate and working PayPal email address updated in their affiliate dashboard. 
‍

6. Termination of Affiliate Account 

We may make amendments to the Affiliate Terms and Conditions that do materially adversely affect your benefits under the Program by giving you thirty 30 days’ notice (“Amendment Notice Period”) in advance prior to its effectiveness by displaying the notification in your Affiliate dashboard.
Should you disagree with such an amendment, you may terminate this Agreement within the Amendment Notice Period, effective on its expiry by informing us in writing. 
When an affiliate account is terminated by the affiliate, unpaid commission above the minimum threshold of £50 GBP will be paid out. Any commissions pending under £50 GBP will be voided. 
Printcomm Solutions Ltd may terminate your affiliate Agreement or suspend access to the affiliate program with immediate effect and without prior notice in the circumstances of fraud and abuse.

7. Limitation of Liability 

Printcomm Solutions Ltd provides no warranty or representation regarding the Affiliate Program, its availability, or the accuracy and completeness of the tracking and reporting systems. The Affiliate Program is provided on an "as is" basis.
